proposal.reason: Primary is workflow: .github/WORKFLOWS.md is rewritten from a full policy reference into an index, and .github/docs/review.md now carries the contribution/review-routing, invitation, approval-gate, and squash-preview guidance that defines review workflow policy ownership. Secondary is ci: .github/docs/ci.md is a substantive extracted CI/PPU execution guide (gates, datasets, CSV case semantics, artifact/cache rules) that is independently maintained by CI expertise. Workflow takes priority because the core functional documentation change is reorganizing review/workflow governance content and its entrypoint, with CI content split out as an additional substantive track.
